facts.text: I am planning a family reunion on my dad's side.
I need help creating a list of relatives to invite.
I need a template or tool to keep track of names and contact information for relatives.
I have a cousin named Rachel who is 16 years old.
I think a spreadsheet option is the most convenient way to keep track of everyone.
I want help setting up columns and rows for a spreadsheet to track relatives.
I want tips on how to organize the spreadsheet so it is easy to sort and filter.
I want a spreadsheet template that includes formulas to automatically count the number of guests, kids, and adults.
I want formulas to calculate the total headcount of guests, kids, and adults.
I want a formula to calculate the total number of households or families attending the reunion.
I want an idea of how many groups of people are coming rather than just individual guests.
I am organizing fun activities for the kids and adults during the reunion.
I want ideas for activities for both kids and adults during the reunion.
I want activities that might be enjoyable for my cousin Rachel, who is 16.

keyphrases: fun activities for kids and adults
